definitions.gloss: ancient document; historical document; old manuscript
definitions.explanation: Official or private documents from past eras, preserved as historical records. Includes letters, decrees, contracts, and other written materials from pre-modern Japan.

examples.japanese: {古文書|こもんじょ}を{解読|かいどく}する。
{蔵|くら}の{中|なか}から{貴重|きちょう}な{古文書|こもんじょ}が{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: A valuable ancient document was found inside the storehouse.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}の{研究室|けんきゅうしつ}で{室町|むろまち}{時代|じだい}の{古文書|こもんじょ}を{調|しら}べている。
examples.english: I'm examining Muromachi-period documents in a university research lab.

notes:
READING:
The standard reading is こもんじょ (not こぶんしょ). The reading こぶんしょ exists but refers more broadly to old writings or classical texts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古文書|こもんじょ}を{解読|かいどく}する (to decipher ancient documents)
- {古文書|こもんじょ}{学|がく} (study of ancient documents, diplomatics)
- {古文書|こもんじょ}の{調査|ちょうさ} (survey of historical documents)
